(Currently Amended) Claim 8: A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from 1 to 99% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 1 to 99% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition is configured to exhibit a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at 200° C for 14 days.

(Original) Claim 9: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone.

(Original) Claim 10: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a polyol selected from the group consisting of neopentyl glycol, trimethylolpropane, pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol.

(Original) Claim 11: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 2 to 15 carbon atoms.

(Original) Claim 12: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid.

(Original) Claim 13: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

(Original) Claim 14: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the composition comprises from 10 to 50% by weight of the at least one polyol ester.

(Original) Claim 15: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises at least one PVE, wherein the at least one PVE is a copolymer of the following two units: Unit 1: Unit 2:

(Original) Claim 16: The composition according to Claim 16, wherein the copolymer comprises from 50 to 95% by weight of Unit 1.

(Original) Claim 17: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 5 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 95% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

(Original) Claim 18: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

(Original) Claim 19: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 35% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 65 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

(Original) Claim 20: The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone.

(Original) Claim 21: The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

(Original) Claim 22: The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid.

(Original) Claim 23: The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

(Original) Claim 24: The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid.

(Original) Claim 25: The composition according to claim 1, wherein the refrigerant further comprises 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane.

(Original) Claim 26: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a pentaerythritol ester.
